historical_scope: The trusted delivery used 0.190-1.1ubuntu0.1 private tool/library inputs and disabled debuginfod. No remote/core, full ABI or performance qualification was established. The frozen ELF tools require a suitable host dynamic-linker environment; the original environment used glibc 2.39 and noted a 2.38 floor.
scope: Local ELF/DWARF/debuglink, eu-unstrip, eu-elflint and damaged-input examples, with five exact Ubuntu DEB inputs and the complete corresponding elfutils source set. GNU fixture construction is a host prerequisite.
